Hi Sanjay — great conversation this morning. Quick recap and a short set of asks so we can align procurement and legal on the right path:

- Recap: Helio is interested in a 6-month pilot (up to 50k tokens/day) to validate clinical note summarization. Key success criteria: accuracy on synth test set, latency < 250ms 95th pct, and data segregation for PHI.
- Near-term asks I promised: vendor intake packet, estimated pricing breakout for pilot, and a suggested kickoff week assuming PO by mid-December.

To move this to procurement quickly, can you confirm: 1) who the economic buyer will be for contract approval (name + email), 2) primary procurement contact for intake forms, and 3) whether Helio requires a purchase order (PO) or prefers a direct invoice to AP?

I've attached our vendor packet and a compact pricing sheet to save your procurement team some back-and-forth. If Helio has a vendor intake template, can you send that back so we match fields?

Proposed next steps:
- You confirm contacts (economic buyer + procurement) — ideally today or tomorrow
- I send a consolidated packet (packet + one-page SOW + pricing) for procurement and legal review
- Tentative kickoff week: Jan 3–7 if a PO is issued by Dec 20 (flexible)

Thanks — copying Marissa (CS) for onboarding notes and Jonas (Finance) for invoice/terms help.

Connor O'Brien
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
connor@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192
